title: The Free Product Promise

ciFast.note: Remote exact-commit verification begins after this locally verified candidate is pushed.

ciDeep.note: No course-output or model-quality change requires a new deep quality claim.

deploy.note: Production deployment and exact-version re-audit are downstream of push and remote verification.

liveProvider.note: The patch changes public product presentation and does not claim a live-provider result.

manualHuman.note: No instructor evaluation, accessibility certification, or classroom validation is claimed.

claims.summary: Every public paid-pilot surface and artifact is removed.
The project publishes an explicit permanent free-product promise.
Search, social, sitemap, and structured data describe only the free application.
Support remains available without creating an EDUTOOL paid tier or upsell.

boundaries: This contract records a locally verified predeploy candidate; remote CI, production deployment, and live re-audit are downstream facts.
EDUTOOL has no paid tier, subscription, concierge service, or application fee.
External AI providers may charge users through their own accounts when users voluntarily supply provider keys; those charges are not EDUTOOL fees.
The patch changes public presentation and policy, not Scion output, model weights, evidence admission, compiler schemas, exporters, or grading policy.
